summary: Omnitek Engineering filed an 8-K disclosing a September 29, 2026 Exchange Agreement with Hard Rock Holdco, LLC under which all membership interests in Hard Rock Ready Mix, LLC were exchanged for 10,000 shares of Omnitek Series A Preferred Stock, making Hard Rock a wholly-owned subsidiary; the deal closed October 1, 2026. Omnitek also issued consulting-firm Hawkeye Digital a five-year warrant for 16,666,667 common shares at $0.004, subject to a 4.99% blocker, under Section 4(a)(2). Two new directors, Kevin Jay Hayes Jr. and Brett Kiker, were appointed. Watch for preferred terms, ownership dilution, and warrant overhang.
